s1.desc: a bedroom with a big yellow bed between two nightstands with lamps

spans.notes: Pax and Polly asleep, Polly's flipper flung across Pax. Slow push-in from ~f13 to the end of the shot: bed edges fit f0 to f20/30/53 at scale 1.004/1.010/1.015 (overlap 1.0 vs 0.76/0.62/0.30 unscaled), and compare f0/f53 shows the whole bed outline doubled. keep12 (median 0.99) missed it. The locked head f0-f12 is under 21 frames

spans.view: with a digital alarm clock on the left nightstand

beats.text: Pax and Polly lie asleep side by side under the blanket with their beaks open
Pax pops up to sit straight in bed as the alarm clock jiggles, and Polly sits up beside him
Pax and Polly sit up in bed blinking sleepily while Polly rubs one eye with her flipper
Pax leans over to the left toward the alarm clock while Polly holds the edge of the blanket
Pax and Polly sink back down and pull the blanket up over themselves

spans.notes: lamp edge fit f54 vs f75/100/117: identity overlap 1.000, camera locked; compare f54/f105 shows bed and nightstands black. The leads are tiny (~8% of the height). Clock digits are in-world text, not transcribed. Whether Pax actually switches the alarm off is hidden behind the bedpost, so the beat only says he leans toward it
Pax and Polly are completely under the blanket, which heaves as they snuggle; only flipper tips show

spans.view: with a digital alarm clock on the left nightstand

beats.text: Pax and Polly lie asleep side by side under the blanket, flippers resting on the edge, eyes closed
Pax opens his beak in a snore and flops a flipper out while Polly rolls toward him
Polly sleeps with one flipper flung across Pax, both of them with their beaks hanging open

spans.notes: headboard and footboard edge fit f118 vs f119-f158: identity overlap 1.000, camera locked (compare f118/f158). Same framing as the pushed-in end of the first shot, but locked here. Polly has a drool drop at her beak from ~f150
